description: Build specification for production renderer dependency chain. Each library documents its required dependencies, version constraints, build configuration, and peak memory usage during compilation.

zlib.requirements: Base compression library. No special configuration needed.

OpenEXR.requirements: HDR image format. Must be built as shared libraries (BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON) because downstream consumers including OpenColorIO and OpenImageIO link dynamically. The renderer plugin system requires shared library loading at runtime. Static archives with PIC are not sufficient.

libjpeg-turbo.requirements: JPEG codec with SIMD acceleration. Required by libtiff for JPEG-in-TIFF compression support.

libtiff.requirements: TIFF format support. JPEG-in-TIFF codec (jpeg=ON) requires libjpeg-turbo to be installed and discoverable at configure time. If libjpeg is not found, the JPEG codec is silently disabled, causing downstream failures when OpenImageIO attempts to read JPEG-compressed TIFF images.

Boost.requirements: C++ utility libraries. Uses b2 build system, not CMake.

Random123.requirements: Counter-based random number generators. Header-only, no build step.

ISPC.requirements: Intel SPMD Program Compiler. Pre-built binary extracted directly to ${INSTALL_DIR}/bin/ispc (flat bin directory, not a subdirectory).

TBB.requirements: Threading Building Blocks. Version must be 2021.1 or later to provide the oneapi::tbb namespace and modern CMake targets (TBB::tbb) required by OpenSubdiv v3.5.0 and USD v23.08. Legacy TBB 2020.x uses the incompatible tbb:: namespace and deprecated cmake integration, which may appear to build successfully but causes ABI mismatches at runtime.

OpenColorIO.requirements: Color management framework. Depends on OpenEXR for EXR format color space support. The dependency direction is strictly unidirectional: OpenColorIO depends on OpenEXR, NOT the reverse.

Embree.requirements: High-performance ray tracing kernels. Requires the ISPC compiler binary at ${INSTALL_DIR}/bin/ispc for SIMD kernel code generation.

OpenImageIO.requirements: Image I/O library. Requires OpenColorIO for color-managed image loading and conversion. All four dependencies must be fully built and installed before OpenImageIO begins configuration.

OpenSubdiv.requirements: Subdivision surface evaluation library. Server-side headless build for the production renderer must disable all GUI and visualization targets: NO_PTEX, NO_OMP, NO_CUDA, NO_TUTORIALS, NO_REGRESSION. The tutorial programs depend on GLFW and OpenGL headers (GL/glx.h) which are not available in the headless server build environment.

USD.requirements: Universal Scene Description. Version 23.08 or later required for OpenEXR 3.x API compatibility. Versions 23.02 and earlier reference the OpenEXR 2.x namespace (Imf_2_5) which does not exist in OpenEXR 3.x headers (Imf_3_1).
